notes: Each entry is a direction-specific public line page, not a route inferred from the line code alone.

Cross-check 2026-11-16: BB and RALIP public Barueri municipal operator indexes were reviewed against the current Cittamobi two-page index and the Prefeitura terminal tables. A553 is an operator-index-only candidate with a 404 individual page and remains incomplete.

The Prefeitura terminal tables currently list 42 distinct municipal codes; A162, A216C1, A631, T249, T253VP1, T651, T652 from the 49-code Cittamobi municipal inventory are not present in those terminal tables. The Prefeitura page is organized by terminal, so these absences require follow-up and are not proof of service cancellation or intermunicipal classification.

2026-11-23: Cittamobi's current Barueri index remains two pages with 113 indexed municipal directions across 49 codes. The existing catalog contains 115 complete direction records: 113 indexed pages plus two additional map-PDF-only directions (T241 Terminal Barueri and T651 Engenho Novo via Rua da Prata). No new complete direction was added this run.

2026-11-23 operator audit: BB Transporte's Barueri index still lists A553, but its linked individual route page returns HTTP 404; A553 is absent from the current Cittamobi index and Prefeitura terminal tables, so it remains an unverified operator-index candidate. 2026-11-23 Prefeitura cross-check: the official terminal tables still list 42 distinct municipal line codes. The seven Cittamobi codes absent from those terminal tables remain A162, A216C1, A631, T249, T253VP1, T651 and T652; absence from terminal tables is not proof of cancellation or intermunicipal classification.
